correctness.rationale: Under the explicit Cayley graph on F_2^4 with generating directions 1,2,4,8,15, r=2 means every induced component has at most two vertices, equivalently induced maximum degree <=1. Recomputed all 65,536 masks independently: exactly 2,142 nonempty faces and f=(16,120,400,660,576,280,80,10). Reconstructed the fixed-order matching: 1,069 disjoint pairs, precisely critical masks 4096,33046,33552,34328; all 9,280 Hasse covers admit a directed topological ordering. Fresh exact signed Morse elimination independently gave D4=(1,1)^T, yielding a contractible degree-one 3/4 pair and S^4, not merely mod-two Betti numbers. A separate full simplicial mod-two rank computation gives reduced Betti 1 only at degree 4. The graph automorphism semidirect structure follows because neighbor-direction permutations uniquely extend from zero and the remaining ten vertices correspond to unique common-neighbor pairs; signed Lefschetz traces in the supplied verifier give +1 on a translation and -1 on two transpositions, determining sign ∘ S5 quotient since generators and conjugacy span. Does not claim an equivariant homotopy equivalence or all folded cubes.
residual_risks: Integral homotopy proof relies on exhaustive finite acyclicity and exact integer incidence calculation for this finite graph; not a general folded-cube theorem.
